name: 95521 · Arcata, CA
findings: ZIP 95521 (Arcata) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 30 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95521 (Arcata) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95521 (Arcata) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
